reader.description: Specialized sub-agent for reading files and searching code — returns summarized results to conserve context

writer.description: Specialized sub-agent for writing and editing files — executes precisely without reasoning, keeping the caller focused on design

executor.description: Specialized sub-agent for running bash commands — returns summarized output instead of raw logs

memory-controller.description: Memory gatekeeper — loads filtered context for agents (progressive tiers), validates and persists memory writes, compacts files that exceed thresholds, and archives resolved entries with a searchable index
